content: Stepanus payao no Anugano Akari Akokoe Yahudi mansamun
Umba Syeno Titi po Stepanus anajo pare, “Ana wo naura tantunawi rai somamo tugae rako?”

Umbawe Stepanus po raura akananto mansai pare, “Injae muno sya arakove wea tenambe, wasamarikoame rasakinav de irati sya ana syo raura so rai. Wusyinoe wama aneno Abraham pana poroto no munijo Haran dainy, yara arono ta no no munijo Mesopotamia, naije wama Amisy, opi titi rave, aroron irati Abraham ai.
Muno Amisye po raura aje ai pare, ‘Abraham, winyo nya munije rapaya muno nya arakove mansapaya tavon. Umba nyoronto no munijo indati Syo rarorono naije rai.’ ”
Stepanus po ayao aneno Abraham raura
“Weti Abraham puje apa munijo Kasdim no no Mesopotamia raora, umba poroto no munijo Haran. Arono no no Haran umaso rai, aja kakai. Umba Amisye po Abraham atutir de no munijo wana raije so rai.

Weramu Amisye po kopa inta ratayao indamu Abraham apave raije ramu, kavinta raunande mamaumbe jewen tenambe. Weramu Amisye po urairije inta rapatimu Abraham ai pare, ‘Winy muno nya susyo nyo mampame indati wapave kopa so rai tenambe.’ Po raurairiveare somaisy weramu Abraham apa arikainye inta aeno aije jewen bayave.

Muno Amisye po raura aje akato pare, ‘Nya susyo nyo mampame indati uta una no munijo maran. Umba vatano una no naije wo mansaijaro arove indamu wanapatambe mai, wo mansantitidi mangkebe awa anakere rai muno wo mansave tatugadi yava tume ama manuije nanto no ratusije mambisy.
Weramu indati Syo mangke raugaje vatano wo mansaijaro arove so mansai. Indati nya ajavi wuje munijo namije raora umba wakare ube sambayambe Rinai no munijo namiso rai jakato.’

Umba Amisye po apa urairije rapatimu Abraham ai pare, ‘Syare winye, anya una no nya yavaruga tenambe nawe, utavondi koano sunat rai, no naiso ti miridije nto, indamu mbe rarorombe Sya urairije umawe rai.’ Maisyare omai ti, Abraham po Isak avaki apa masyote kaumandeij, naije be sunative to. Noa Isak po Yakob avaki, umba Yakob po wama aneno abusyin eane jirum mavaki.
Inta apa tame mirati Yusup. Wepirati apa arakove uparijo ai, weti wo amavun nanto vatano marane inta ai, naije po augavo arove wuruta no munijo Mesir. Weramu Amisye tuna Yusup autan tutir

muno Po apaya apa siurije umaso rai. Amisye po vambunine raugaje Yusup ai ti akarikuga mba dave, weti Akarijo Titi Firaon anayanambe ai. Umba Firaon po Yusup aijaseo be akarive apa yavare rai muno po vatano Mesir maijar tenambe.”
Stepanus po ayao aneno wusyine ratodi
“Arono naije maroro akoe nande no munijo Mesir muno munijo Kanaan rai tenambe, weti vatane awa siurije mangke dave. Muno wama anene nao tavon unanta anaisye inta raije ramu.
Weramu Yakob po ranaun ware anaisye mamo mawes no munijo Mesir. Weti po apa arikainye matutir indamu wuruta no Mesir, wo anaisye inta ramavun. Soa umba manasyin dave wama anene wuruta kai no Mesir.
Noa wuruta jirum akato, umba Yusup aroron irati mai weye onawamo apa arakove nanawije. Muno Akarijo Titi Firaon po ranaun Yusup apa arakove ude.
Umba Yusup po apa arakove matutir indamu wo ajayo Yakob muno apa yavaruga tenambe mawainde no Mesir. Wenanawamo awa wanuije nanto no abusyine kaururum eane nadani.
Weti Yakob poroto no Mesir. Arono una no Mesir umaso rai, Yakob kakai muno apa arikainye ugwenen tavon.
Awa kopa mamo raugav akare no munijo Sikem indamu rantuna no aipapo wemirati wusyinoe aneno Abraham po doije veano ramavuno Hemor apa arikainye mansaije rai.”
Stepanus po ayao aneno una no Mesir raura
“Umba masyoto Amisye po raurairive aneno Abraham aijoe nande mararai. Arono naije wama aneno Israel utantuna no Mesir umaso ubakipambea wanuije nseo rave.
No ava akarijo titi wanyin inta be akarive no Mesir rai jakato. Weramu akarijo titi umaso pantatukambe aneno Yusup ai.

Weti akarijo titi umaso po vatano Israel maponae manakoe muno po mave tatugadi. Po mansantitidi indamu awa arikainyo wo mano aje kai mapaya awa akoe mansai, maugaveta unaki mumuimbe no min indamu ugwenen.
Arono naije Musa ano, opamo arikainyo ko dave. Embae mandeij apa vatan anui yo aeranande no yavar.

Umba yo Musa umaso augaveta yo apaya niki marambe, mamaisyo Akarijo Titi Firaon apa ayao maje rai. Weramu Firaon apa arikainyo wanya inta nanto irati Musa ai, naije mbekero ai kobe ti mo augav mo akum maisyare muno taune ama arikainy.
Weti Musa opamo po ananyao Mesir ranyao tenambe ti daen bintabo. Panakoe umba apa ayao muno apa ana dave mamo mbambunin dave.”
Stepanus po ayao aneno Musa ratodi jakato
“Arono Musa apa tume tename jirum, umba beker pare po apa arakovo Israel mapan.
Arono to po mansaen, naije vatano Mesir inta po vatano Israel inta ave tatugadi. Musa nanto yai, umba po vatano Israel apaya yara po mangke raugaje vatano Mesir ai, po aubai kobe.
Musa po rakarae pare apa arakovo Israel indati wo raen wepamo vatano Amisye po apatimu indamu po mapaya awa siurije rai. Weramu vatano Israel unanta raije ramu.
Siman akato Musa puje po apa arakovo Israel inta yaen isyivuinyo vambinibe. Musa beker indamu yaneme raijar, weti pare, ‘Ibeanimaibe risivuiny? Yara taune ribuipije pa umba!’

Weramu vatano po apa arakova anepate umaso pari, weti po Musa avakanto marambe, po raura pare, ‘Mbeanimaibe irati ririmare insivuiny weramu winyo ririnsansopi?! Are pirati po naijaseo wimbe akarive muno nyo mangke rapatimugo ririnsai?
Namanawe nyo vatano Mesir aubai to, weti soamo nyare nyo inaubaisy akatoare naije mai dako?!’
Arono Musa po apa ayao umaso ranaun, nin kobe ti to no munijo Midian. No no Midian umaso rai, baunam, apa arikainyo anya jiruma yaeno ai.

Musa no no munijo Midian tume tename jirum. Masyote inta noeve no nugo vabukane vono maninimbe mararaijo Unato Sinai rai, umba po taname inta raen mbadurur no randa uga umbuga kanen. Muno naito Amisye inta arorono ai, nande no tanamo namije ama uga rai.
Musa perananto po aen weti paparo ai. Arono piridije to mararai indamu po raen kobe, naije tavon po Amisye anamote ranaun mare,
‘Risyamo nya anene awa Amisye pi Risy; nya aneno Abraham muno Isak muno Yakob awa Amisye pi Risy.’ Musa po ranaun jani dave weti tutar, ponae po ranyanyut akatowi.
Amisye po raura nanto ai pare, ‘Syo mino nteto raije wato ratayao ti ngkakavimbe, weti najo kokome rapaya.
Syo sya kawasae una no Mesir awa siurije raen to. Syo awa wanonae ranaun to. Ride indamu Syo mapaya awa siurije rai. Weti, Musa winde, Syo natutir nyakato no Mesir.’ ”
Stepanus po ayao Musa be akarive raura

“Musa so pirati vatano Israel manasyinoe wonae ai, wo awatan no marambe, ware, ‘Are pirati po naijaseo mbe akarive reansai muno nyo mangke rapatimu?’ Weramu naito Amisye arorono Musa ai no tanamo mbadurure rai, weti Amisye taune po Musa apatimu indamu be akarive vatano Israel mai muno po mapaya irati munijo aro Mesir rai.
Musa so pirati po maugavuje Mesir raora. Po anapaporainyo manui raroron no Mesir muno Mayano Nijam muno no nugo vabukane vono maninimbe arono vatano Israel wanya raija tume tename jirum.
Musa so pirati po raura nanto vatano Israel mansai pare, ‘Masyoto rijat Amisye indati po wapa arakove inta atayao no wapa susye rai, Po aijaseo be anawaebe wasai maisyare rinamaisy.’

Muno Musa so pirati no wama anene mautan arono wanunugambe no nugo vabukane vono maninimbe mararaijo Unato Sinai rai. Arono naije naito Amisye inta po raura nanto Musa ai no unate rai, muno Musa be marimbe ti po ayao umaso raura nakato no wama anene mansai. Weti Musa so po ayao njayaisy raugav no Amisye ai indamu po raugakaje wansai jakato.”
Stepanus po ayao vatano Israel wo yare ranarije raura
“Weramu wama anene wonae ubeta Musa apa ayao rai, muno wonae Musa ai tavon. Yara ubeker ware wakata no Mesir.

Wo raura nanta aneno Harun ai ware, ‘Nyo yare inta ranari reansai indamu wamo raijaro wama usye rai mo wama unanuije raroron. Musa wato pamo po wansaugavuje Mesir raora, weramu soamo veanimaibe po wansapaya vayave yara poroto no unato warae? Pakare rainy, weti reamantatukambe animaisye mirati nande ai to.’
Weti wama anene wo yare inta ranarijo sapijo tuvane anyi. Umba wo maere inta raotar wo rameseo yare umaso ai. Muno wo ono manakoe rave indamu wo awa yaro wo ranarije umaso raijaseo titive.

Maisyare omai ti, Amisye pari wama anene mansai, weti akirive mai muno Po mansapaya indamu utavondi taune awa bekere rai. Weti wama anene ubeaje irati uma pe embae me tumo ntuna no naumo warae rai tenambe. Awa anaubeare umaso mamaisy irati anawae wusyin inta po ratoe rai no taiso:

content.text: Amisye po raura pare, ‘Inya, vatano Israel!
Arono wapanya no nugo vabukane vono maninimbe tume tename jirum,
anakotaro wapo rameseo, wemamo wapo rameseo Rinaije ramu.
Yara wapo yare inta yanari indamu wabeaje obo yai.
Wapo yaro Molok apa tuna raije ranawan wapanya autan, muno yaro tumo Repan atavon, ti yare so wenanairati wasanuga nto irati yai.
Maisyare omai ti, Syo wasamauta marambe
indamu wata no munijo aro Babel.’ ”

content: Stepanus po ayao yavaro sambaya Amisy aije raura
“Wusyinoe arono wama anene wanya no nugo vabukane vono maninimbe, wo randume ranari indamu ube sambayambe Amisye ai, wo ranari mamaisyo Amisye po rarorono Musa ai ti po raene rarijati.

Umba randumo namije wemirati wama anene wo raugav arono Yosua be akarive mansai, po mansaugav usen no munije so rai. Umba Amisye po vambunine raunande wama anene mansai indamu wo vatano utantuna no naije mawatambe tenambe munijo namije raora. Muno randumo Amisye umaso mamo wama anene wo raijaro mautan ava arono Daud be akarive.
Daud opamo Amisye anayanambe ai muno po Amisye anajo pare, ‘Amisy winyirati reama aneno Yakob be sambayambe Nai! Koveamo syo yavare ranari Namarom indamu reambe sambayambe Naijo rai rako?’
Weramu Salomo wepirati po Yavaro Amisye umaso ranari.
Weramu Amisye pamo titi rave, weti tuna irati yavaro vatane wo ranari raije jewen. Maisyare muno anawae wusyin inta po ratoe no taiso:

content.text: ‘Naumo warae omamo Sya tuna raije mije
muno mine so mirati inajo unane nteto rai.
Risyirati syo nuge so ranari tenambe muno anakotaro ntuna no ama uga raije ranari tavon.
Weti yavaro wapare wapo rauseo nteto Rinamarom mamaisye ramu tenambe.
Muno munije inta mamaisyo rituna raije ramu.’ ”

content: Stepanus po raura nanto Anugano Akari Akokoe Yahudi mansai

Anugano Akari Akokoe Yahudi wo Stepanus apa ayao aneno Yahudi umaso raraniv tenambe. Umba Stepanus po raura nanto mai pare, “Weapamo vatano wasakari matu! Muno wasanuga matu weti waponae wabeta Amisye ai! Wasamarikoame mpapakiri weti wapo Amisye apa ananyaowe ranauman. Waponae wapo Anawayo Vambunine raraniv maisyare muno wapa anene mansamaisy!

Wapa anene wo anawae wusyine mansave tatugadi tenambe. Muno wo anawae inta maubaisy, nanawirati wo raurairive ware Mesias indati de, wepirati Vatano mamai dave pije. Soamo Mesias uma wo aurairive so de to, wepirati Yesus. Weramu weap akato wapo amavuno vatano wo Amisye aene jewene mansai, umba wapo aubaisy.
Weapirati wusyinoe Amisye apa naite wo Apa ananyao raugaje Musa ai indamu wapo raijar. Weramu wabeta raije jewen!”
Vatano Yahudi wo orame veano Stepanus aepar
Arono akari akokoe Yahudi wo Stepanus apa ayao umaso ranaun, upari rave muno manuga mamuno ai.
Weramu Anawayo Vambunine mo vambunine raugaje Stepanus ai, weti amun mbeseo perato no naumo warae umba po Amisye apa varo ngkovo ntiti raen muno po Yesus aen te no Amisye anem ngkove rai.
Naije Stepanus po raura pare, “Waperasea no warae! Weye syo naumo warae raen nsaneka muno syo Arikainyo Vatane aen te no Amisye anem ngkove rai.”
Akari akokoe Yahudi wonayo Stepanus apa ayao umaso rai rave, weti wo mamarikoame rakakuvu muno ugwagwaimbe. Naije kobe wavave wo Stepanus aijar,

wo akarimu usya munijo namije raora ware indamu wo orame rave amaug. Naije vatano wo Stepanus angkivan umawe wo awa ansune rapapaya, wo raugaje ntuna vatano mansae inta arijat, apa tame mirati Saulus.
Arono wo orame veano Stepanus amaug, opamo be sambayambe po raura seo Amisye ai pare, “Amisy Yesus, Nyo inanawayoe aijar.”
Umba po vukane ranteter, gwaino akoeve pare, “Amisy Yesus, vemo Nyo awa ayao kakaije so raunanto wo ranawan inya, yara Nyo rapaya mansai.” Umba anawayo karimu anasine raora, kakai kobe.
